claims.statement: The Commission says CRA reporting obligations apply from 11 September 2026, with an early warning within 24 hours and a fuller notification within 72 hours for specified exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents.
Before market placement, manufacturers must draw up technical documentation, perform the applicable conformity assessment, issue an EU declaration of conformity, and affix CE marking.

The CRA applies to products with digital elements made available commercially whose intended or foreseeable use includes a direct or indirect connection to a device or network, while specified categories are excluded.

contrary_evidence: The main product obligations generally apply later than the September 2026 reporting duties, so some buyers may postpone full release-control spend.
Certain regulated products and non-commercial open-source software are outside or differently treated under the scope.
Existing secure-development and product-lifecycle platforms may absorb the required evidence with configuration rather than replacement.

economics.acquisition_route: Choose one device niche, run readiness assessments through two security consultancies, convert repeated evidence gaps into a product, and distribute through those firms
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated 5-7 year scenario: 100 manufacturers averaging 60,000 PLN recurring revenue gives 6.0m PLN; at 32% EBITDA, 4x, and 70% founder ownership, equity value is about 5.38m PLN.
economics.founder_time: 18-24 hours weekly for niche discovery and prototype; external product-security expertise covers high-consequence reviews
economics.gross_margin_basis: Evidence collection, validation, and versioning are scalable; security assessment and conformity advice remain partner services
economics.payback: Customer payback hypothesis: preventing one delayed launch or replacing recurring manual technical-file assembly can exceed a 50,000-120,000 PLN annual fee; quantify during readiness pilots
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 25,000-75,000 PLN implementation plus 36,000-120,000 PLN annual license by product-family and repository count
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every release, component change, vulnerability, support decision, and authority request depends on historical product evidence

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Product-version/component/control lineage and reusable remediation patterns become more valuable with every release and vulnerability event
fingerprint.customer: Polish and EU SMEs manufacturing or private-labelling network-connected hardware, industrial devices, and IoT products
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded-security consultancies, test laboratories, notified-body-adjacent advisors without implying endorsement, hardware accelerators, and importer associations
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Evidence graph, risk/control templates, component/change monitoring, release checklist, technical-file export, and timed incident workflow; hypothesis 25,000-75,000 PLN setup and 36,000-120,000 PLN annually
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Head of engineering, product security, or compliance pays implementation and an annual license per product family, with optional incident readiness
fingerprint.problem_trigger: New product release, substantial modification, component vulnerability, support-period change, or reportable exploited vulnerability/severe incident

founder_fit: Fits AI-assisted document extraction, data lineage, anomaly detection, and software workflow design
Narrow high-value B2B buyers reduce social and camera demands
Can start with scoped paid readiness work before building broad integrations
Founder can hire domain review while retaining technical product ownership
risks: Security or compliance errors could expose customers and the company to severe liability
DevSecOps, product-lifecycle, and GRC incumbents may extend into CRA evidence
Hardware customers can have long integrations and procurement cycles
A checklist product without build-system integration would be easy to copy and weakly retained

structure.commercial_archetype: Engineering release-control SaaS with implementation and incident-readiness retainers
structure.control_point: The signed internal evidence package that authorizes a connected-product version to proceed to conformity assessment and market release
structure.critical_dependency: Deep integration with source/build/component and product-change systems plus credible cybersecurity and conformity interpretation

thesis: Planning-stage hypothesis: sell a release gate for smaller manufacturers and importers of connected hardware, industrial controllers, and IoT products that links cybersecurity risk assessment, component inventory, test evidence, support-period commitments, technical documentation, declarations, and vulnerability-response ownership to each shipped version. The product does not certify compliance; it blocks internal release when the manufacturer's chosen evidence is missing and preserves the approved technical file. Incident workflows can reuse the same product/component graph for the CRA's short reporting windows. The defensible position is inside engineering change control, not as a one-off policy generator.
title: Cyber Resilience Act Release-Evidence Gate
uncertainties: Which connected-product niche lacks an incumbent and has enough common evidence structure
How final harmonised standards affect technical evidence expectations
Whether customers will permit repository/component metadata access
Security-review and cyber-insurance cost for a small vendor
